crossRefs.note: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.
So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

parallels.note: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.
translations.bsb: After Joshua had dismissed the people, the Israelites went out to take possession of the land, each to his own inheritance.
translations.kjv: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
translations.asv: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
